confirm.title: Configure EasyTouch thermostat
confirm.description:
Set up **{name}**.

Leave the password blank if your thermostat has no password set.

init.title: Bluetooth adapter
init.description: The thermostat keeps a Bluetooth connection open all the time, so it uses a connection slot on whichever adapter or proxy it connects through. Home Assistant picks that by signal strength, which can put too many held connections on one adapter. Choose one here to spread them out yourself. The Bluetooth Path sensor shows the one in use.

data.adapter_fallback: Use another adapter if this one is unavailable

data_description.adapter: Automatic lets Home Assistant choose. The list shows the adapters and proxies that hear this thermostat, strongest first.
data_description.adapter_fallback: Only used when the chosen adapter hasn't heard the thermostat recently or has no free slot.
